entry_thesis: Close the 15 million euro long. The Nov 24 close at 1.0963 is through the 1.0992 invalidation, and the pro-growth replacement is a 5 million Australian dollar long at 0.6641, where RSI 22 and a 5.5 percent one-month decline have priced a break that copper at 5.36 and the S&P at 7237 have not confirmed. Softer US yields, with the two-year down 17bp to 4.63, ease dollar financial conditions while the risk is an 08:30 growth print weak enough to extend the Australian dollar decline.
